text: Figure 4.1: Image of the PWM channel for diagnosis [SRS_Pwm_12297] The PWM driver shall provide a service for setting the period of a selected channel ⌈ Description: The PWM driver shall provide a service for setting the period of a selected channel. The parameters shall be • PWM channel • PWM period • PWM duty cycle This functionality is available only for the PWM channel configured as type of channels "Variable Period". Rationale: The PWM duty cycle parameter is necessary to maintain the consistency between frequency and duty cycle. Otherwise, the effective duty cycle would change when the period is validor the PWM driver would have to recalculate the valid duty cycle by itself. ▽
